clue.text: Card with form of identification for VIP

parts.note: a king is a court card in a pack of playing cards
a PIN is a personal identification number, typed in to prove who you are

explanation.surface: Someone presents a card and an ID document to be admitted as an important guest.
explanation.definitionFit: A kingpin is the most important person in an organisation, a very important person.

clue.text: Oriental gown, a novel old number

parts.note: Kim is a novel by Rudyard Kipling

explanation.surface: A Japanese robe from an old book, numbered.
explanation.definitionFit: A kimono is a long, loose traditional Japanese robe.

clue.text: With dangerous weapons to get rid of, United Nations turn up first

indicators.note: first says this reversed piece goes at the start
in a down clue, turn up means the letters read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to clear is to remove or get rid of

explanation.surface: A UN resolution on disposing of dangerous weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests disarmament talks; 'turn up' works because this is a down clue, so the letters read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuclear describes arms using atomic energy, the most dangerous weapons.

clue.text: Assumes Joshua's position?

parts.note: the Book of Joshua comes just before the Book of Judges in the Bible, so it stands in front of Judges

explanation.definitionFit: To prejudge is to assume a verdict before hearing the facts; split, it reads before Judges.

clue.text: Handle with some circumspection a metamorphosis

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Treat a transformation with a degree of caution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handle' looks like a verb; here it is a noun, slang for a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Handle is informal slang for a person's name or nickname.

clue.text: Girl let out, returning in the interval

indicators.note: returning says the two pieces, girl and let out, are read together backwards

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
to emit is to let out or give off

explanation.surface: A girl is released and comes back during the intermission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns the whole run GALEMIT into TIMELAG; 'in the' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: A time lag is a delay or gap between two events, an interval of time.

clue.text: Bellicosity displayed by flustered uncle breaking ceasefire

indicators.note: breaking means the jumbled word splits the ceasefire and sits inside it

parts.note: a truce is a ceasefire

indicators.note: flustered means agitated, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An agitated relative breaks a truce and shows aggression.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'flustered uncle' looks like a character in a family row; 'flustered' is the anagram signal and 'breaking' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Truculence is aggressive defiance, an eagerness to fight.

clue.text: Nonsense rhyme

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of disbelief, like rubbish or fiddlesticks
the phrase's two words rhyme with each other

explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation dismisses something as nonsense, and its two words chime together as a rhyme.

clue.text: Corrupt fellow, I

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Corrupt fellow, I (7)' for LOWLIFE: the definition 'Corrupt fellow' leaves only 'I', which cannot give the letters; the clue looks cut short and no source gives the rest.

clue.text: Keep seeing each other's shadow swirl, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak says the words are spoken and heard as something else

parts.note: a ghost is a shadow or phantom, and an eddy is a swirl of water

explanation.surface: A ghostly shadow seems to swirl around a couple.
explanation.walkthrough: GHOST EDDY said quickly sounds like the dating phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To go steady is to date one person regularly as a couple.

clue.text: Insignificant, animated character …

definitions.meaning: informally, something ... is trivial or amateurish

explanation.definitionFit: The cartoon mouse's name became slang for anything second-rate or trivial, so it fits both senses.

clue.text: … used to be observed going west

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means reading from right to left, backwards

parts.note: saw is the past tense of see, to observe

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, a cartoon character that once existed was seen heading west.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of the verb to be, so it means existed formerly, used to be.

clue.text: From pole to pole, part of eye is drawn back to disfiguring mark

parts.note: N stands for the north pole

indicators.note: drawn back says the piece of the eye is read backwards

parts.note: the uvea is the pigmented middle layer of the eye
S stands for the south pole

explanation.surface: An anatomical description of a scar stretching across the eye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'From pole to pole' sets N at the start and S at the end, with AEVU (the uvea reversed by 'drawn back') between.
explanation.definitionFit: A naevus is a birthmark or mole, a mark on the skin that can disfigure.

clue.text: Take action about commoner backed as certain to succeed

indicators.note: about means the legal action word goes around the other piece

parts.note: to sue is to take legal action against someone

indicators.note: backed says the comparative word is written backwards

parts.note: rifer means more widespread, more common

explanation.surface: Someone takes action to support a commoner, confident of winning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'commoner' reads as a noun for a non-aristocrat, but it is the comparative adjective, more common; 'backed' and 'about' are the two signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Sure-fire is an idiom for guaranteed to work, bound to succeed.

clue.text: 11 blemishes arising by mistake inside

indicators.note: in a down clue, arising means the word reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: warts are skin blemishes

indicators.note: inside means the error goes within the other word

parts.note: to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Skin marks come up because of an error.
explanation.walkthrough: '11' is a cross-reference: the definition is the answer to 11-across. 'arising' and 'inside' are the reversal and container signals.
explanation.definitionFit: A strawberry mark is a red birthmark, a kind of the 11-across skin blemish.

clue.text: Bishop produces red herring — vet baffled

indicators.note: baffled means confused, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bishop puts forward a misleading clue and leaves the vet puzzled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'baffled' rearranges the thirteen letters of RED HERRING and VET.
explanation.definitionFit: Right Reverend is the formal style of address for an Anglican bishop.

clue.text: Being worried, sixteen taken to church

indicators.note: taken to says the church abbreviation is attached at the end
worried means fretted, so the letters are disturbed

parts.note: taken as written
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An anxious sixteen-year-old is brought to church.
explanation.definitionFit: Existence is the state of being, of being alive or real.

clue.text: Horned viper I reckon to start with H

parts.note: the asp is used for several venomous snakes including the horned viper
to rate is to reckon or judge

explanation.surface: Someone considers whether a snake's name begins with H.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspirate a word is to pronounce it with an initial breathy H sound.

clue.text: People reaching out for self-analysis

parts.note: souls means people, as in a village of a hundred souls

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the next word are disordered

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: People reaching out to others as a way of examining themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Soul-searching is close examination of one's own motives and conscience, a form of introspection.

clue.text: Johnny-come-lately has good times with floozy

parts.note: ups as in ups and downs are good times
tart is slang for a floozy

explanation.surface: A newcomer enjoys himself with a disreputable woman.
explanation.definitionFit: An upstart is someone who has newly risen to importance, a newcomer.

clue.text: Concerned with writing letter, couched in considerable elegance

indicators.note: couched in means lying within, so the letter sits inside
considerable means a large part but not all, so the last letter of the elegance word goes

parts.note: grace means elegance
phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A calligrapher's letter shows great refinement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'considerable' signals that the elegance word loses its last letter, a lot of it but not all; 'couched in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Graphic means relating to writing or drawing, as in the graphic arts.

clue.text: A doctor; one introduced to me and chatty bird

indicators.note: introduced to means the pieces are put inside the word me

parts.note: a GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A doctor and someone else are introduced to me by a talkative bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The magpie is known for chattering, and a chatterbox is often called a magpie.

clue.text: Popular writer to furnish dedication

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a scribe is a writer or copyist

explanation.surface: A best-selling author agrees to write a dedication.
explanation.definitionFit: To inscribe a book is to write a dedication in it, providing a dedication.

clue.text: Port? Superior to, I agree, German or Spanish wine

indicators.note: in a down clue, superior to means placed above, so this piece comes first

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port, known as Rio
ja is German for yes, I agree

explanation.surface: A drinker asks whether port is better than German or Spanish wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Rioja is a red wine from the Rioja region of northern Spain.

clue.text: Classes with plan to lose a stone

indicators.note: to lose says one piece is dropped from the other

parts.note: a stratagem is a cunning plan
a gem is a precious stone

explanation.surface: Social classes hatch a scheme to get rid of a stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Strata are layers or levels, as in social classes or ranks of society.

clue.text: Superior sweets served up

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the word reads upwards

parts.note: gums are chewy sweets, such as fruit gums

explanation.surface: Fancy confectionery is brought to the table.
explanation.definitionFit: Smug means self-satisfied, with a superior air.

clue.text: Military official in a state

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation of Georgia, a US state

explanation.surface: An army officer serving within a particular state.
explanation.definitionFit: An aga was a military commander or official in the Ottoman Empire.

clue.text: Rowers provide crew for vessel, a seagoing craft

parts.note: an oar can mean a rower, so oars are rowers
to man a ship is to provide it with a crew
a ship is a sea vessel

explanation.surface: A rowing team supplies the crew for a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' means skill, not a boat: the skill of rowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Oarsmanship is skill at rowing, a craft practised on the water.

clue.text: Mouth — or say — true exchanges

indicators.note: exchanges means the letters swap places with each other

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction about speaking honestly in a conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: An estuary is the wide mouth of a river where it meets the sea.

clue.text: Soldier overcome by exhilaration in Scots valley

indicators.note: overcome by means the soldier is held inside the feeling

parts.note: glee is high spirits or exhilaration
NCO is a non-commissioned officer, a soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier is overjoyed while in a Highland valley.
explanation.definitionFit: Glencoe is a glen in the Scottish Highlands, site of the 1692 massacre.
